title: UN climate summit COP31 opens in Antalya, Turkey
caption:
The UN climate summit COP31 opens today in Antalya, Turkey, with nearly 200 countries taking part until 20 November. Turkey hosts the talks while Australia chairs the negotiations. The hosts want a global goal of getting 35% of energy from electricity by 2035, but fossil fuels and climate finance are expected to be the hardest issues. World leaders are due to speak on 11 and 12 November.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
